cases.situation: Our Salesforce implementation partner hasn't answered our ticket about broken lead routing in 9 days. Sales team is losing inbound leads. I want to go to their account manager, Priya, directly.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, ticket #SF-3391 has been open since 17 September with no update since the 19th. Lead routing broke after the last deploy and about 40 inbound leads a day are landing unassigned, so our reps are missing first contact. We've sent the error logs and a screen recording twice. Can you get a consultant assigned by end of day Thursday and confirm here? If that's not possible, I need to know now so we can route leads manually.
cases.note: Facts with dates, impact in numbers, what you've tried, one ask with a deadline.

cases.situation: 我们项目依赖另一个组的接口，对接的同事小刘一直说'快了快了'，已经拖了两周，下周五就要上线。我打算找他们组长，但想先跟小刘打个招呼。
cases.reply: 刘哥，先跟你说一声，免得你从别人那里听到：订单接口的事我今天会跟张组长提一下，主要是下周五就要上线了，时间实在压不住。不是针对你，我知道你手上排了好几件事。后面沟通我都会抄送你。
cases.note: 越级之前先打招呼，说清是时间问题不是人的问题，这是升级和背刺的区别。

cases.situation: I emailed my manager Tom twice (Sept 12 and 19) that our biggest client's contract renewal needs a pricing decision by Oct 1, he hasn't replied, he's swamped with the merger. Going to his boss Anita now.
cases.reply:
Subject: Decision needed by 1 Oct: Delmar renewal pricing
Hi Anita, I raised the Delmar renewal with Tom on the 12th and 19th, and I know the merger has him stretched. Delmar's contract ($310k a year) expires 1 October and they've asked for a 6% discount to sign a three-year term. I need a yes or no on the 6% by Wednesday so legal can turn the paperwork. My recommendation: approve it, since three years locks in the account through the migration. Tom is copied.
cases.note: Say you tried the manager first, copy him, keep it under 150 words, and close with your recommendation.

cases.situation: Mein Internet ist seit dem 10. September komplett weg, ich arbeite im Homeoffice. Zwei Störungsmeldungen, der Technikertermin am 22. ist ohne Nachricht ausgefallen. Ich will jetzt eine Beschwerde, die wirklich weitergeleitet wird.
cases.reply:
Betreff: Dritte Meldung, Anschluss seit 10. September ausgefallen, Kundennummer 4471 2290
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,
dies ist meine dritte Meldung zum Ausfall meines Internetanschlusses seit dem 10. September. Bisherige Ticketnummern: 88120 und 88341. Der Technikertermin am 22. September wurde ohne Nachricht nicht wahrgenommen. Ich arbeite von zu Hause und bin seit drei Wochen auf mobile Daten angewiesen. Bitte leiten Sie den Fall an Ihr Beschwerdemanagement weiter und bestätigen Sie mir bis Freitag, 2. Oktober, einen verbindlichen Technikertermin. Andernfalls wende ich mich an die Schlichtungsstelle der Bundesnetzagentur.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Sabine Krause
cases.note: Ticketnummern und Daten statt Adjektive, eine Bitte mit Frist, und nur einen nächsten Schritt ankündigen, den man auch wirklich geht.

cases.situation: I escalated to my director Paul that our Quantix data contract lapses Oct 15 and legal needs to review the renewal. He replied 'not a priority this week, Q4 planning first.' If it lapses, the trading desk loses its daily pricing feed.
cases.reply: Understood, Q4 planning comes first this week. So I can plan: if legal hasn't reviewed the Quantix renewal by Tuesday 13 October, the contract lapses on the 15th and the trading desk loses its daily pricing feed. Can you confirm in writing that we're accepting that risk, or tell me who else can approve legal's time? I want to make sure it's a decision and not a default.
cases.note: When they say it isn't a priority, don't argue: restate the dated consequence and ask for the risk to be accepted in writing, or for another decision-maker.

cases.situation: I run a small agency rebuilding a client's website. Their marketing lead, Josh, owes us the product copy and photos, 3 weeks late now, and launch is Nov 2. He keeps saying 'this week'. I told Josh yesterday I'd raise the timeline with their COO, Linda. Now the email to her.
cases.reply:
Subject: Decision needed by Fri 2 Oct: website launch date

Hi Linda, the 2 November launch is at risk. We still need the product copy and photos for 40 pages, originally due 8 September. Josh and I have spoken three times since, and he knows I'm raising the timeline with you. Two options: launch on the 2nd with the 15 core pages and add the rest by 20 November, or move launch to Monday 16 November. I recommend the phased launch, and we'd need the core page content by Friday 9 October. Could you let me know which by this Friday?
cases.note: Escalating to a client's sponsor is about the date, not Josh: say he knows, give two options and a recommendation.

cases.situation: 我在一个家居品牌定制了衣柜，合同写9月10日安装，全款23,600元已付。安装师傅两次爽约，客服工单开了三个，一直说在协调。国庆要接父母来住。想发一条能真正被升级处理的投诉。
cases.reply: 您好，这是我第三次就同一订单反映问题，请转交主管或售后负责人处理。订单号YJ20260812，定制衣柜，全款23,600元已于8月12日付清，合同约定9月10日安装。之后约好的9月15日、9月22日两次安装都没有上门，也没有提前通知。已有工单号：GD0915、GD0922、GD0926。请在9月30日（周三）下班前给我一个确定的安装日期，并由负责人电话联系我。如果届时没有答复，我会向12315投诉。
cases.note: 顾客升级投诉：订单号、金额、爽约日期和工单号列清楚，只提一个要求和一个截止时间，说出的后果要真的会去做。

cases.situation: I sent my teammate Marcus a heads-up, then escalated our stuck data migration to our manager Helen because the client cutover is Oct 16. Helen reassigned part of it. Now Marcus messaged me: 'Could've just talked to me instead of going to Helen.'
cases.reply: I hear that it landed badly, and I'm sorry it felt like going around you. I sent you the note first because I didn't want you blindsided, but I can see a message isn't the same as a conversation. The date was what worried me, not your work. I'd rather sort things out with you than around you. Can we grab ten minutes today at 3?
cases.note: When the person you went past is upset, don't defend the escalation; acknowledge it, restate that it was about the date, and ask to talk.

cases.situation: On Sept 22 I escalated to Hannah, the regional manager at our letting agency, because our boiler has been out since Sept 14 and the maintenance line kept saying 'booked in'. I asked for a repair date by Friday. Nothing back. I have a two-year-old and it's getting cold at night.
cases.reply: Hi Hannah, following up on my email of 22 September: the Friday deadline has passed and I haven't had a reply. The boiler at Flat 3, 14 Carlow Road has now been out for 15 days, and the nights are getting cold with a two-year-old in the flat. Are you the right person to book the repair, or should I take it to someone else? Either answer helps. If I don't have a repair date by Thursday 1 October, I'll contact the council's private housing team.
cases.note: An ignored escalation: reply on the same thread, restate the facts and the one ask, and only name a next step you'll actually take.

cases.situation: Two weeks ago I escalated our invoice rounding bug to my director Aisha, after sending a heads-up to Kenji on the platform team, who owned it. Aisha got it prioritised and Kenji's fix shipped yesterday. He did all the actual digging. I want to close the loop with him.
cases.reply: Kenji, update: the rounding fix went out yesterday, and Aisha has confirmed the October billing run on Monday the 5th is clear. I've told her the diagnosis was yours; you'd found the currency conversion bug before it ever reached her. Thanks for sticking with it while it sat in your queue.
cases.note: Closing the loop with the person you went past: the outcome, and the credit where the work was done, so the escalation doesn't read as a takeover.

cases.situation: Trabajo en un almacén en Getafe. La carretilla elevadora número 3 tiene el freno de mano fallando desde el 15 de septiembre; se lo dije al jefe de turno, Raúl, el 15 y el 22, y la siguen usando. Ya le he avisado a Raúl de que escribo a la jefa de planta, Elena.
cases.reply:
Asunto: Decisión necesaria hoy: carretilla 3 con el freno de mano averiado
Hola, Elena: la carretilla elevadora número 3 tiene el freno de mano fallando desde el 15 de septiembre; en la rampa del muelle 2 se desplaza con carga. Se lo comuniqué a Raúl el 15 y el 22, mantenimiento aún no la ha revisado y se sigue usando en todos los turnos. Raúl sabe que te escribo. Te pido que la retires del servicio hoy hasta que mantenimiento confirme que es segura. Mi recomendación: etiquetarla como fuera de servicio y cubrir su trabajo con la carretilla 5, que está libre por las tardes.
Gracias,
Andrés Molina, turno de mañana
cases.note: Con un riesgo de seguridad el plazo es hoy: hechos con fechas, lo ya intentado y una sola petición. Si no hay respuesta, el siguiente paso es el delegado de prevención.
